[/size][size=4][b]Mineral Town is a quaint village full of friendly residents that lies to the east of Pelican Town. Here, you can explore new places, make new friends, and potentially even find your soulmate. With new fish to catch and goods to acquire, Mineral Town will bring a new experience with an old twist!

Goddess Spring

...And More!
